ui.badge: No account · your files stay on your device
ui.endText: FaLe PDF runs in the browser, on your phone and on your computer.

sign.title: Sign PDF – no account needed | FaLe PDF
sign.description: Sign a PDF on your phone or computer: draw your signature once, save it and place it with one tap. No account, no upload.
sign.lede: Draw your signature with your finger or mouse and place it in any PDF with one tap – contract, form or power of attorney.

steps.d: Open the PDF in FaLe PDF and choose “Fill & Sign”.
Tap “Signature” and draw it once. FaLe remembers it for next time.
Tap the line, adjust it with “Larger” or “Smaller” and tap “Save”.

why.d: Your signature and the document are processed on your device – nothing is uploaded.
Add text, the date, check marks, initials and your own stamps just as easily.
Signing works with no watermark and no account.

faq.q: Is the signature legally valid?
faq.a: You add a simple electronic signature – like on paper, only digital. That is enough for many everyday documents. Where the law requires a special form (for example a qualified signature), that form applies.

faq.q: Is my signature stored?
faq.a: Only on your device, so you can place it with one tap next time. You can delete it at any time.

faq.q: Does it work on a computer?
faq.a: Yes. FaLe PDF runs in the browser and can be installed as an app on Windows and Mac. On a computer you draw with the mouse or touchpad.

faq.q: Can I fill in form fields too?
faq.a: Yes. If the PDF has form fields, you fill them in the same step and sign afterwards.

fill.title: Fill in PDF forms – also on your phone | FaLe PDF
fill.description: Fill in PDF forms: text fields, check boxes and drop-downs on your phone or computer – or type onto a scanned paper form. No account.
fill.lede: Fill in form fields, or simply type where something belongs on a scanned form – with large text and clear buttons.

steps.d: Open the PDF and choose “Fill & Sign”. Existing fields are highlighted.
Tap a field and start typing. For forms without fields, tap “Text” and then the spot on the form.
Add the date, check marks and your signature if needed, then tap “Save”.

why.d: A scanned paper form has no fields – you still type in exactly the right place.
Text size with A− and A+, colours with one tap, everything in one bar at the bottom.
FaLe also opens special official forms (XFA) that otherwise only open in one particular PDF program.

faq.q: What if the form has no fields?
faq.a: Tap “Text” and then the spot on the form. For tick boxes there is “Check mark” with ✓, ✗ or a dot.

faq.q: Can I change the form later?
faq.a: When saving, the fields are normally fixed so nobody can change them unnoticed. If you want to change something later, untick the option to fix the fields before saving.

faq.q: Are my entries uploaded?
faq.a: No. Filling in happens entirely on your device.

faq.q: What about forms that only show “Please wait …”?
faq.a: These are usually special official forms (XFA). Open them with “Fill in official form” in FaLe PDF.

edit.title: Edit PDF – add text & images | FaLe PDF
edit.description: Edit a PDF on your phone or computer: add text and images, replace existing text, cover areas. No account and no upload.
edit.lede: Add text and images, change existing text or cover areas – right in your PDF.

steps.d: Open the PDF and choose “Edit PDF”.
Use “Text” to write something new, “Replace” to tap existing text and change it, and “Image” to add a photo or logo.
Tap “Save” – the new version is in your files and the original is kept.

why.d: “Replace” picks up the font size and colour of the spot, so the change fits in.
Size with A− and A+, bold, colour – no hunting through menus.
Even features others only offer with a subscription come without a watermark here.

faq.q: Is the old text really removed?
faq.a: When replacing, the old text is covered. For confidential passages that must be removed from the file for good, use “Redact”.

faq.q: Can I add images and logos?
faq.a: Yes, JPG and PNG. Move and resize them with your finger or mouse.

faq.q: Does it work offline?
faq.a: Yes. After the first visit, editing also works without internet.

faq.q: Is my original kept?
faq.a: Yes. A new version is saved; you can replace the original if you want to.

merge.title: Merge PDF – combine several PDFs into one | FaLe PDF
merge.description: Combine several PDFs into one file and choose the order – on your phone or computer, without an account and without uploading.
merge.lede: Combine invoices, scans or chapters into a single PDF – in the order you want.

steps.d: Open “Merge” and tap “Add documents”.
Drag the files into place or use the arrows.
Tap “Merge” – the new PDF is in your files right away.

why.d: The files are combined on your device – confidential papers stay with you.
Even hundreds of pages are processed quickly without the app freezing.
Then compress, sign or share – all in the same app.

faq.q: How many PDFs can I merge?
faq.a: As many as your device can handle. There is no artificial limit.

faq.q: Can I leave out single pages?
faq.a: Yes. With “Organize pages” you delete, rotate or reorder pages before or after merging.

faq.q: Does the text stay selectable?
faq.a: Yes. The pages are taken over unchanged, so text stays selectable and searchable.

compress.title: Compress PDF – for email and uploads | FaLe PDF
compress.description: Make a PDF smaller so it fits into an email or an upload form: shrink images or pack it losslessly. Without uploading.
compress.lede: Too big for an email or an online form? FaLe PDF makes the file smaller – you see the size before and after.

steps.d: Open the PDF and choose “Compress PDF”.
“Shrink images” for scans and photos, “Lossless” for text documents or “Strong” for the smallest file.
Tap the button – you see right away how much smaller the file has become.

why.d: For large scans, “Shrink images” is already selected – as readable as before.
If nothing more can be saved, FaLe tells you instead of saving a worse file.
Even large files are compressed on your device.

faq.q: Does the quality get worse?
faq.a: “Lossless” doesn't change the look. “Shrink images” only recalculates photos and scans, text stays sharp. “Strong” turns every page into an image.

faq.q: Does text stay selectable?
faq.a: With “Lossless” and “Shrink images”, yes. With “Strong” the pages become images.

faq.q: How small will the file get?
faq.a: That depends on the content. Scans and photos usually shrink a lot, pure text files less.

faq.q: Is there a size limit?
faq.a: No, only the storage of your device.

scan.title: Scan documents with your phone – as PDF | FaLe PDF
scan.description: Scan documents with your phone camera: edges are detected, the page is straightened and enhanced, and the text becomes searchable. No account.
scan.h1: Scan a document with your phone
scan.lede: Hold your phone over the paper – FaLe finds the page, straightens it and turns it into a clean PDF.

steps.d: Open the scanner and hold your phone over the page. The edges are detected automatically.
Adjust the corners if needed and choose a filter such as “Enhanced” or “Black & white”.
Tap “Save PDF”. If you like, the name is suggested from the content.

why.d: Skewed photos are straightened, and filters such as “Enhanced” brighten shadows and grey backgrounds.
Text recognition (German and English) runs on your device – afterwards you find every word.
Scan as many pages as you like into one PDF and reorder them with a tap.

faq.q: Do I need internet?
faq.a: No. Only text recognition downloads its language data once the first time; after that everything works offline.

faq.q: How is the file name chosen?
faq.a: If you leave the name field empty, FaLe suggests a name from the content after text recognition. You can change it with one tap.

faq.q: Can I use photos from my gallery?
faq.a: Yes. Choose “From album / files” and pick existing pictures.

faq.q: Is there an ID card mode?
faq.a: Yes. “Scan ID card” puts the front and back at their original size on one A4 page.

word.title: Convert PDF to Word – no upload | FaLe PDF
word.description: Convert a PDF into an editable Word document (DOCX): paragraphs, headings and bold text are kept. Right on your device.
word.lede: Turn a PDF into a Word document you can edit – paragraphs, headings and emphasis are kept.

steps.d: Open the PDF and choose “PDF to Word”.
“Editable text” rebuilds paragraphs and headings, “Exact layout” takes over every page exactly as in the original.
Tap “Convert to Word” – the document is in your files and can be edited right away in FaLe.

why.d: The conversion runs on your device – your documents never leave it.
Pages without text can be turned into text with text recognition (German and English).
FaLe PDF has its own editor for Word documents – no other program needed.

faq.q: Does the Word document look exactly like the PDF?
faq.a: With “Exact layout”, yes – but then the text cannot be edited. “Editable text” keeps the content and structure; the look may differ slightly.

faq.q: Can I convert only certain pages?
faq.a: Yes. Enter the pages, for example “1-3, 5”.

faq.q: Which format do I get?
faq.a: A Word document in DOCX format that opens in all common word processors.

xfa.title: Open and fill in XFA forms – official forms | FaLe PDF
xfa.description: Official form only shows “Please wait …”? FaLe PDF opens XFA forms, fills them in, signs and saves them – also on your phone.
xfa.h1: Open and fill in an official form (XFA)
xfa.lede: Some forms from authorities and embassies only show “Please wait …” or an empty page. FaLe PDF opens them, you fill them in and save them again.

steps.d: Open the PDF in FaLe PDF. If FaLe recognises an official form, “Fill in form” appears.
Fill in the fields. On a signature line, one tap opens the signature pad.
“Save” keeps the original form, as the authority expects it. “As a normal PDF” and “Print” also contain your signature.

why.d: These forms otherwise only open in one particular PDF program – FaLe opens them in the browser, on your phone and on your computer.
Simply zoom in on small boxes – ideal on a phone.
Program code inside the form is never run, for safety reasons, and nothing is uploaded.

faq.q: How do I recognise an XFA form?
faq.a: A normal PDF viewer often only shows the note “Please wait …” or an empty page. FaLe recognises such forms automatically.

faq.q: Will the authority accept the saved form?
faq.a: “Save” keeps the original format with your entries. If a normal PDF or a print-out is required, use “As a normal PDF” or “Print”.

faq.q: Do calculations in the form work?
faq.a: Scripts in the form are not run, for safety reasons. Enter automatic totals or checks yourself.
